title: Shin Ultraman
description: After the accidental death of a human during battle, Ultraman takes on the man's appearance and place at the S-Class Species Suppression Protocol to protect Earth from further threats.

title: Yuzo: The Biggest Battle in Tokyo
description: Yuzo Ooki is unexpectedly fired; managing to find a new job, Yuzo navigates the maze of crazy coworkers; Yuzo is undaunted, but he is bullied by his new workmates and dumped by his girlfriend.

title: The Grindhouse
description:
S01 E05 — Lady frankenstein
Lady Frankenstein is a typical exploitation sex & horror flick from the early 1970s; for the most part, it has one distinguishing quality that elevates it from the usual dross: its leading lady, Rosalba Neri.
